observations: Photo 0 shows a used torque converter and transmission bell housing assembly on the ground, with "02" stamped on the converter cover, surrounded by other engine parts and tires in a workshop.
Photo 1 shows a dirty used V-engine with an attached transmission lying on pavement, with intake manifold, hoses, and wiring visible.
Photo 2 shows a used inline-4 engine with an attached transmission on the right, four exhaust ports visible, lying on pavement with a wrench nearby.
All three photos carry the watermark "POSTED ON JIJI CHIDO MOTOR". No Toyota badge, engine code, or model number is readable in any photo.

identity.kind: used car engine and transmission parts

claims.claim: We sale all types of Toyota parts
claims.evidence: No Toyota branding, engine code, or part number is visible in the photos; the seller's text alone cannot prove these are Toyota parts.

risks.risk: The engines and transmissions may not run or shift
risks.proof: A video of each engine starting and running, and each transmission engaging gears

risks.risk: The parts may not be Toyota or may not fit the buyer's vehicle
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of engine block codes, transmission tags, or Toyota emblems

risks.risk: Internal damage such as cracked blocks, worn bearings, or seized components is not visible
risks.proof: Borescope inspection photos or a teardown showing internal condition
risks.if_unproven: priced as-is with hidden internal damage risk

proof_requests: Close-up photos of any stamped engine codes, VIN plates, or manufacturer tags on each block and transmission
A short video of each engine starting and running, and each transmission shifting through gears
Photos of the underside and bell housing of each transmission to check for cracks or leaks
response.reason: The items are visibly used engine and transmission assemblies, so they can be valued at their worst case as non-running cores even without verifying the Toyota claim or running condition.
